rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub TimeStr() If pv_BIN.Value == false Then DayValue.text = "000 дней" TimeValue.text = "00:00:00" Else
Dim NowTime as Date Dim Day_Now as Int Dim Month_Now as Int Dim Year_Now as Int Dim Hour_Now as Int Dim Minute_Now as Int Dim Second_Now as Int
Dim Second_Passed_Now as UInt64 Dim Seconds_Difference as Uint64
Dim Days_Passed as Int Dim Hours_Passed as Int Dim Minutes_Passed as Int Dim Seconds_Passed as Int
TimeDetected = (pv_BIN.FieldTime)
NowTime = STime//Now() delta_time=DateDiff(NowTime, TimeDetected)
seconds=delta_time % 60 minutes=(delta_time/60) % 60 hours=((delta_time/60)/60) % 24 days=(((delta_time/60)/60)/24)
if (1 < days) && (days < 5) then days_txt=' дня' else if (days == 1) then days_txt=' день' else days_txt=' дней' end if end if
if(days<10) then days_st='00'+ CStr(days) else if(days<100) then days_st='0'+ CStr(days) else days_st=CStr(days) end if end if
if(hours<10) then hours_st='0'+ CStr(hours) else hours_st=CStr(hours) end if
if(minutes<10) then minutes_st='0'+ CStr(minutes) else minutes_st=CStr(minutes) end if
if(seconds<10) then seconds_st='0'+ CStr(seconds) else seconds_st=CStr(seconds) end if
DayString = days_st + days_txt TimeString = hours_st + ":" + minutes_st + ":" + seconds_st DayValue.text = DayString TimeValue.text = TimeString
End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: Set pv_BIN = BIN(PID) If pv_BIN == Nothing Then HasError = true DayValue.text = "???" DayValue.fill = "Col_Grey2" TimeValue.text = "???" TimeValue.fill = "Col_Grey2" SelArea.title = "Ошибка привязки объекта " + PID Exit Sub End If //SelArea.title = SelArea.title + " " + PID
